surprises_or_findings: Spillover into src/lib/agent-launcher.ts (1 new exported function listAllStatusWaveBeads, ~50 LOC, additive sibling of listOpenWaveBeads). Surfaced and recorded via bd update --append-notes per builder.md Step 5d Step 3 option (a). The spillover was unavoidable: the new predicate needs a reader that returns wave-N beads of ANY status (open + closed); the existing listOpenWaveBeads filters out closed beads via `if (child.isClosed) continue;` and the helpers it uses (execBdSync, parseChildrenFromTree) are not exported from agent-launcher.ts. The cleanest scoped fix was to add the sibling reader where listOpenWaveBeads lives, mirroring the established pattern.

PER_ACTION_PRECONDITIONS count test changed from 10 to 11. The new predicate shares the `NO_WAVE_BEADS` refusal code with PRECOND_WAVE_BEADS_EXIST so the sorted-codes assertion now includes NO_WAVE_BEADS twice. Two predicates with the same RefusalCode is intentional and architecturally safe: appliesTo() filters on action name (review-wave for the new predicate, start-wave/resume-build for the old), so they fire on disjoint action sets. The shared code matches the integration test's enum-subset assertion (`expect(['NO_WAVE_BEADS', 'ALL_WAVE_BEADS_CLOSED']).toContain(payload.refusalCode)`) so no downstream test broke from the shared code.

The integration test AC #2's original description ('all wave:4 beads closed') was misleading — the test mocks `mockListOpenWaveBeads.mockResolvedValue([])` which is ambiguous between 'no beads exist' and 'all closed'. The pre-fix code happened to refuse on either via PRECOND_WAVE_BEADS_EXIST. Post-fix, only the 'no beads exist' (phantom) case refuses; 'all closed' is the legitimate success state per the 1cb58a5 fix. Updated the test description and added an inline comment clarifying the new dual-signal semantic.

Pre-existing TypeScript errors (97) are unchanged by this bead's changes (verified by `git stash + npx tsc --noEmit + git stash pop`). None of the pre-existing errors are in src/lib/dispatch-preconditions.ts, src/lib/agent-launcher.ts, or the two test files modified by this bead. The errors live in unrelated files (research test, agent-launcher-marker-detection, dolt-lifecycle, commit-manager, stuck-in-stage).
